# Rakuten

> > Rakuten is a cashback rewards platform connecting millions of shoppers to 3,500+ partner stores for earning cash back on purchases.

Rakuten operates as a leading affiliate shopping network that bridges consumers and major retailers including Amazon, Sephora, Expedia, and hundreds of others. Members earn cashback rewards ranging from 2-3% across various shopping categories including fashion, beauty, travel, and electronics.

## Key Topics

- Cashback rewards
- Promo codes
- Shopping deals
- Affiliate network
- Sign-up bonuses
- Loyalty programs
- Browser extension
- Mobile app
- Partner merchants
- Cash back rates
- Coupon codes
- Shopping companion
- Rakuten affiliate
- Ebates
- PayPal integration
